activate.description: Bring Messages to the foreground without selecting a conversation or sending.

activate-direct.description: Foreground Messages without selecting a conversation.

requires_confirmation: A recipient-specific compose request must name the exact recipient; Send remains manual
prohibited: prefilling message body text or attachments
inventing recipients or opening private conversation identifiers
reading conversations, recipients, contacts, notifications, or account state
safety.uncertain_outcome: A compose sheet may already be open. Inspect with the user and never replay.

data_access: No conversations, contacts, recipients, or account state are read
data_sent: An exact caller-supplied recipient only when prepare is explicitly requested
privacy.retention: No recipient, screenshot, conversation data, device identifier, or raw response is committed.
